rule_reason: The stated interaction cost includes one separation made by distance, so its reading turns around; the coupling and separated objects have no partners.
closing: The main statement mechanically turns around because it lists one distance-made separation. The alternate statement has no cost and therefore keeps, exposing dependence on the chosen statement. No full word-map formula can be written without inventing partners; the empty formula records that failure rather than a reformulation.
